name: Lucide
summary: Open-source icon library of 1600+ consistent SVG icons, with official packages for React, Vue, Svelte and more.
description: Lucide is a community-made icon toolkit providing 1600+ vector SVG icons with a strict, consistent design style (24px grid, 2px stroke, customizable color, size and stroke width). The site has a browsable, customizable icon gallery and guides for every integration; official packages cover Web (Vanilla), React, React Native, Vue, Svelte, Preact, Solid, Angular, Astro and static SVG, and are tree-shakable so you only ship imported icons. Aimed at designers and developers who need one coherent icon set across projects.
contains: 1600+ SVG icons in one consistent stroke style
official packages: Web (Vanilla), React, React Native, Vue, Svelte, Preact, Solid, Angular, Astro, static SVG
browsable icon gallery with a customizer for color, size and stroke width
tree-shakable imports: only the icons you use ship
SVG files, sprite, icon font and SVG string JS modules
ISC license; Feather-derived icons under MIT
